beats.text: Five books that quietly change how you see the whole world.
One. The Republic — Plato. The cave that makes you question everything you take for real.
Two. Meditations — Marcus Aurelius. See events as they are, not as your fear paints them.
Three. Candide — Voltaire. A savage, funny demolition of easy optimism about the world.
Four. The Metamorphosis — Kafka. How quickly the world withdraws its love when you can't perform.
Five. Siddhartha — Hesse. That wisdom is found by living, not by being told.
Some books give you facts. These give you new eyes. Full explainers on the channel.

source_note: Full retellings of each are on ReadLark.
